Daughters of the Seven Seas  
Why did you come to the Rose Planet?  
Here, the Devil in the darkness  

Has seized  
Your silence and your fate.

text:
Crews with the National Park Service have been coating the bottom of the drained pool with "American flag blue" paint. Swimming or wading in the landmark is prohibited, according to the NPS.

President Trump said the renovation project will take a week and cost $2 million.
